name: Super Normal
effect: You lose Critical Delight's non-crit penalty and never critically fail an attack roll: a natural 1 still misses if it doesn't meet AC, but triggers no fumble effects. Your crit range is 18 to 20, non-crits deal +50% damage, and crits deal triple damage plus PB d20.

name: Still Water
effect: Entering either stance activates both, and you can still counter while in stance. In stance, you take half damage from all sources and can make up to 3 Stand Off counters per round. Each successful counter deflects the attack onto a nearby enemy and adds 1 turn of stored damage (up to PB) to your guaranteed teleporting strike.

name: Elemain's Fancy Criticals
effect: Your ricochets use your Critical Delight crit range (10 to 20) instead of only a natural 20, and each ricochet crit builds and benefits from Critical Delight's multiplier.

name: Shooting Gallery
effect: Each ricochet triggers a Level 3 Travert's Echo (three pulses for 25% of the ricochet's damage in a 10 ft ring around each target hit), and any kill from a ricochet or its echoes banks an echo.
